purpose: Give precise, verifiable credit to people who materially help JANUS research while protecting privacy and avoiding implied endorsement or collaboration without consent.
principles: Credit concrete contributions, not status or prestige.
Public naming requires explicit or clearly documented consent to public attribution in the JANUS context.
A person may choose full name, role/institution only, pseudonym, or anonymity.
Do not imply that a data custodian endorses JANUS conclusions merely because they supplied data or archival assistance.
Negative, null, and falsifying data contributions receive the same attribution respect as apparently confirmatory contributions.
Where applicable, cite the original dataset, archive record, DOI, licence, accession, or custodian-provided provenance alongside the human credit.
Separate research contribution from evidence authority: helpfulness does not increase the scientific weight of the data beyond its provenance and quality.
claim_boundary: Public attribution records assistance and provenance only; it must not be presented as endorsement of JANUS hypotheses, interpretations, or conclusions.
